description:

additional_info.subject: ID0413026-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P5 170000510] Outlets OOO CRM:02023000546
additional_info.body:
Dear Fabien Ferreira,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Vikas
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P5 170000510
Charger ID/Serial No.
:
E7UBEl
Problem Description
:  Outlets Out of order.
Troubleshooting:
We have reviewed the Active error flag and found that one of the doors is open, which is causing the charger to display the "outlets out of order" message. Could you please check if the door has been opened and, if so,  please close it? Additionally, we will investigate the PLC update logs and provide you with an update soon.
For future reference, your case number is
0413026
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
